messages:
morgan_sales: Heads-up — Sirius (fintech) wants to proceed with a POC but legal is blocking on KMS/HSM + data residency. They also want a capability matrix that compares our Private/on‑prem offering to CompetitorA and CompetitorB, plus a clear Dedicated vs Hosted POC cost breakdown. Attaching their RFP. TL;DR: SOC2, KMS BYOK, audit logs, SLA 99.9, on‑prem option.

anya_se: @morgan_sales quick checklist: SOC2 Type II — yes we have the report; KMS integrations — AWS/GCP/Vault supported; HSM — partner integration only (requires SOW); Data residency — region locking + Private VPC; SLA — Dedicated has SLA, Hosted is best-effort for standard tiers. I'll drop a capability matrix draft and the RFI answers. :white_check_mark:

devin_se: Pricing note — for a 3mo POC w/ ~50 req/s steady and spikes to 200: recommend Dedicated small pool (equiv 4x A10G) or Hosted with burst. Ballpark numbers below; will refine after we get exact QPS and sequence length.

devin_se: ```
# POC cost calc (ballpark)
Dedicated reserve: $12,000/mo * 3 * 0.5 (POC disc) = $18,000
Hosted variable: est $8,000/mo * 3 = $24,000
Eng + SE support: $7,500 flat for POC
Total (Dedicated): $25,500
Total (Hosted): $31,500
```

jordan_legal: On KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys for Hosted and Private. HSM-provisioned keys require our partner (Thales) and an SOW — expect 4–6 weeks for provisioning and attestation docs. Send their encryption-at-rest requirements and whether they need FIPS 140-2 assurances. We'll include our security appendix and SOC2 report in the RFI response.

ops-bot: Attached: /attachments/sirius_rfp.pdf, capability_matrix_draft_v1.xlsx, poc_checklist_v2.md. Internal link: https://redwood-internal/attachments/1945/sirius (requires SSO).

matt_eng: For on-prem: we can provide an air-gapped bundle but need customer's infra spec (GPU model, count, networking). Quantization recommendations: INT8 (q8) will reduce GPU needs ~3–4x vs FP16 for throughput but affects some model accuracy depending on model family. With 8 A100 equiv GPUs and q8 we should hit ~200 rps for short-context workloads; confirm model + seq len.

sanjay_infra: Network peering checklist: need customer IP ranges, required ports (443, 9100 for metrics, 22 if they want support SSH), and any egress rules. For VPC peering we need a support ticket + security review — expect 3 business days. If they want private connectivity to their KMS, that adds config time.

anya_se: I'll consolidate answers into the RFI doc and update the capability matrix to show feature parity vs CompetitorA/B (on-prem, KMS, SLA, pricing tiers, compliance). @morgan_sales can you confirm the POC acceptance criteria and target success metrics (latency, throughput, error budget)?

morgan_sales: Will get acceptance criteria from Sirius infra this afternoon and confirm SLA expectations. Plan to return the RFI + capability matrix by EOD Friday. If legal flags anything else I'll loop Jord an. Thanks all :pray:

#morgan_sales_note: Next steps: 1) Morgan to collect POC metrics + customer's KMS/HSM ask 2) Anya to update capability matrix and RFI draft 3) Devin to finalize POC cost calc after exact QPS/seq len 4) Jordan to prepare security appendix + SOC2 5) Ops to push attachments to customer link once we have NDAs.
